notes: Scrapper Clans "Slag Pot" (scrap, 3x3, manned): a riveted iron cauldron on four stubby legs, no frame round it. Scrap goes in the top: a rusty hopper top-right tips into it, and a half-melted hazard-striped hull plate and a pipe end are still sinking in the slag. A welded rust patch on its side, a hand wheel on the left that tips it (the operator's post) and a cracked gauge with an amber lamp; a pour lip bottom-right dribbles into a rusty ingot tray with hazard tape. The on loop: the crust drifts, bubbles pop in turn, the plate bobs, a drop falls from the lip, the fresh ingot dims, and the fire under it flickers on the floor (glow). Damaged: the side has split above a leg and molten weeps onto the floor, the patch plate hangs by one bolt, the gauge needle is pinned in the red. Disabled: a cold grey cake with the plate stuck in it, the back-left leg snapped and its foot lying loose, the patch fallen off onto the floor, the tray kicked askew.
